comment: Normalized UUID stem from volume path — primary key
Human-readable PDF name
Full /Volumes/... path to the source PDF
Report title extracted from the PDF
Customer / site name
Primary ESN — doc-level, resolved via preprocessor + enrichment. Used for IBAT/Event Vision lookup.
Primary equipment type (e.g. Generator, Gas Turbine) — doc-level for primary ESN only
Doc-level Gas Turbine ESN anchor emitted by preprocessor (non-exhaustive if multiple GT ESNs exist)
Doc-level Generator ESN anchor emitted by preprocessor (non-exhaustive if multiple Generator ESNs exist)
Equipment system ID from IBAT — primary ESN only. TODO: extend to per-ESN lookup for secondary ESNs.
Equipment sub-class / code from IBAT — primary ESN only. TODO: extend to per-ESN lookup for secondary ESNs.
Event type (e.g. Call-Out, Inspection)
Event Vision project ID
Event Vision equipment event ID
OFS event ID
FSP project ID
Additional project ID (pipe-separated if multiple)
FSR document number
Date the FSR was issued — format: YYYY-MM-DD
Outage start date — format: YYYY-MM-DD
Outage end date — format: YYYY-MM-DD
Outage type — resolved from PSOT table
Technology type — resolved from PSOT table
Name of the person who prepared the report
Name of the person who approved the report
LLM-generated full-document summary
Number of pages in the PDF
File size in bytes
Last modified timestamp from volume listing
Volume path to persisted parsed.json used by P1/P2 parse-once flow
Parser version used to produce parsed_volume_path (e.g. pypdf2_v1.0, pymupdf_v1.0)
JSON array of char-offset regions with per-region ESN + equip_type metadata — used by P2 for chunk attribution
JSON array of ESNs marked inactive (not applicable this outage)
P1 text extraction method (e.g. pypdf2_v1.0) — experiment tracking
P1 preprocessor version (e.g. preprocessor_v2_final) — experiment tracking
P1 LLM model for doc-level field extraction (e.g. gpt-4-turbo, claude-3-sonnet) — experiment tracking
P1 LLM prompt template version (e.g. v1, v2_with_hints) — experiment tracking
Overall FSR v2 pipeline version (e.g. fsr_v2.0) — experiment tracking
Unique run identifier (e.g. run_2026-07-18_exp_001) for grouping across documents in single run — experiment tracking
P1 status: pending / completed / failed
Error message if P1 failed
Number of P1 attempts on this document
P2 status: pending / in_progress / completed / failed
Error message if P2 failed
Number of P2 attempts on this document
When this row was first created (file discovery)
When P1 last completed or failed
When P2 last completed or failed
When any field was last modified (status, error, retry count, etc.)
